ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate the central surface area with a ratio of approximately 80:20 against low-intensity black perimeter borders and the median wedge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zones on the left and right lobes; thick black border along the entire trailing edge; vertical black bifurcation at the median notch; focal black spots present on the lower-left and mid-right white surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with an estimated angle of 50 degrees; depth is roughly 1/8th of the total vertical fluke height visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations on the distal 20% of the trailing edges; low-frequency, irregular nicks along the medial trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge displays a strong concave curve leading to tapered distal tips; leading edge displays convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast brownish-gray clusters with irregular textures on both the left and right distal tips, corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, dark linear marks visible on the white ventral surface, particularly a cluster of diagonal lines on the lower-left lobe and a vertical streak on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and ragged edges on the distal tips; extensive parasitic colonization (barnacles) on the outer margins.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, elongated dark pixel cluster located in the mid-section of the right lobe's white field.
